query: SELECT id AS "id!: VfAccountId" FROM ((SELECT id FROM vf_accounts WHERE status = $1 AND (id < $4) AND ($4 IS NOT NULL) AND ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vf_account_flags f WHERE f.account_id = vf_accounts.id) >= $2) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $3) UNION ALL (SELECT id FROM vf_accounts WHERE status = $1 AND ($4 IS NULL) AND ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vf_account_flags f WHERE f.account_id = vf_accounts.id) >= $2) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $3) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $3) __ids ORDER BY id DESC
